full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cinematic photograph contains a wide horizontal scene held between broad black bars at the top and bottom. In a crowded interior, an older man in a dark pinstriped suit stands on the right, turned slightly toward the shadowed figure at the left edge. His short gray hair is neatly combed, round dark glasses sit over his eyes, and a white shirt and patterned tie show beneath the jacket. His lined face catches pale overhead light while his shoulders descend into heavy shade. Across the middle left, a large film camera with a projecting lens and several boxy attachments points into the room; the dark equipment is partly silhouetted against bright haze. A second suited man in a brimmed hat stands farther back on the left, softened by the light and intervening camera. At the extreme foreground left, the close profile and hat of another person form a nearly black shape that frames the scene. Overhead round lamps shine as large white disks, while a brighter ornate fixture sits near the upper right. Glass panels and angular trim along the right wall reflect smaller pools of light. The background stays crowded but indistinct, with atmosphere softening faces and machinery beyond the main figures. Film grain and high contrast give the image a physical, slightly worn surface rather than a clean digital shine. The ceiling fixtures supply hard bright spots and spill diffused light through the haze, leaving the near profile and lower corners in deep shadow. The overall composition layers dark silhouettes, lit faces, and bulky equipment across a narrow horizontal frame for a tense, observational film-set mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白电影式照片把一条宽幅横向场景夹在上下两道宽黑边之间。拥挤的室内里，一位穿深色细条纹西装的年长男子站在右侧，身体略朝左边缘的阴影人物转去。他的短灰发梳理整齐，眼前戴圆形深色眼镜，外套内可见白衬衫和花纹领带。布满纹路的脸接住上方浅光，肩膀则沉入厚重阴影。画面中部偏左，一台大型电影摄影机带突出的镜头和几块方形附件，朝室内伸出；深色设备在明亮薄雾前部分形成剪影。更远的左侧，另一位戴宽檐帽的西装男子站着，受光线及前方摄影机影响而显得柔化。最靠近画面左侧边缘的一个人只露出近距离侧脸和帽子，形成近黑色框景。上方的圆灯亮如大白圆盘，右上附近另有一盏更繁饰、更亮的灯具。右墙的玻璃板和棱角饰线反射较小的光斑。背景虽拥挤但不清晰，空气感柔化主要人物之外的面孔和设备。胶片颗粒与高反差赋予图像真实而略磨旧的表面，而非洁净的数字光泽。顶灯形成强烈亮点，并在薄雾中散出柔光，让近处侧影和下方角落留在深影里。整体构图在窄横画幅里叠放暗剪影、受光面孔和庞大设备，形成紧张而观察性的片场气氛。
style_prompt_en: The image has a cinematic photographic treatment organized by close foreground occlusion, compressed middle layers, and bright practical light in the distance. Dense shadow holds broad shapes, while small high-value pools reveal selected surfaces and leave much of the setting unresolved. Hard luminous points diffuse through haze, creating halos without erasing crisp near contours. Grain gives smooth tonal fields a subtly physical surface. The composition uses unequal dark masses at the edges to push attention toward a narrower lit passage, with overlapping silhouettes carrying depth. A restrained grayscale range can preserve detail inside the midtones even when highlights approach white and shadows approach black. The overall effect is intimate, crowded, and tense, shaped by staged contrast and atmospheric falloff.
style_prompt_zh: 画面采用电影式摄影处理，由近处遮挡、压缩的中间层次和远处明亮的实景灯光组织。浓密阴影保留大块形体，少量高明度光区揭示被选中的表面，让环境许多部分不完全清楚。强亮光点穿过薄雾散开，形成光晕却不抹去近处清晰轮廓。颗粒使平滑明暗区域带微弱的实体质感。构图用边缘不等大的暗块把注意力推向较窄的亮部通道，重叠剪影承担纵深。节制的灰阶在亮部接近白色、暗部接近黑色时，仍保留中间调细节。整体效果亲密、拥挤而紧张，由布置过的反差与空气衰减塑造。
theme_en: A black-and-white cinematic interior with an older suited man beside a film camera
theme_zh: 一位年长西装男子站在电影摄影机旁的黑白电影室内场景
name: Martin Scorsese
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
